no_tasks_match_filters: No tasks match the current filters.
today_tasks_tooltip: Active tasks scheduled for today; if a task has no scheduled date, its due date is used instead. Up to five are shown, ordered by priority.
overdue_tasks_tooltip: Active tasks with a due date before today. Up to five are shown, starting with the most overdue.
upcoming_tasks_tooltip: Active tasks due from today through the next seven days. Up to five are shown, ordered by due date.
filter_widgets_tooltip: Opens the options to show or hide dashboard widgets. Your selection is remembered for next time.
total_tasks_tooltip: Number of tasks OBS Agenda detects in the vault, regardless of whether they are pending, in progress, or completed.
completed_tasks_tooltip: Number of tasks whose status is completed. This is not limited to tasks finished today.
pending_tasks_tooltip: Number of tasks still in the pending state; tasks in progress and completed tasks are excluded.
in_progress_tasks_tooltip: Number of tasks marked as started but not yet completed.
productivity_tooltip: Percentage of detected tasks that are completed: completed tasks divided by the total number of tasks.
high_priority_tooltip: Number of tasks with High or Highest priority; medium, low, and unset priorities are excluded.
estimated_time_tooltip: This widget is currently disabled. Calculating estimated task time has not been implemented yet.
no_date_tasks_tooltip: Number of tasks without a due, start, scheduled, completion, or cancellation date. A creation date does not count as a planning date.
completed_this_week_tooltip: Number of tasks completed in the last seven days, based on their completion date; this is a rolling period, not a calendar week.
completion_trend_tooltip: Compares tasks completed in the last seven days with the previous seven days and shows the percentage change.
completion_ratio_tooltip: Average number of tasks completed per day over the last seven days: tasks completed in that period divided by seven.
consistency_tooltip: Percentage of the last seven days on which at least one task was completed. Each day counts once, even if several tasks were finished.
system_health_tooltip: Percentage of tasks the parser recognizes as valid. If there are no tasks, this indicator shows 100%.
invalid_tasks_tooltip: Active tasks the parser marked as invalid because of field issues. Up to five are shown for review.
oldest_tasks_tooltip: Active tasks with a creation date, ordered from oldest to newest. Up to five are shown with their age in days.
project_tasks_tooltip: Active tasks grouped by the vault's root folder. Up to five folders and three tasks per folder are shown.
language_description: Select the language for the agenda.

errors.invalidDate: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid date or contains extra text.
errors.invalidPriority: Icon {icon} should not have extra text.
errors.invalidCompletion: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid OnCompletion value.
errors.invalidDependency: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid dependency list.
errors.invalidRecurrence: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid recurrence pattern.
errors.invalidRecurrencePattern: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid recurrence pattern.
errors.invalidTime: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid time (HH:mm).
errors.invalidDuration: Icon {icon} is not followed by a valid duration in minutes (e.g. 90m).

task_update_error: Couldn't update the task (the file may have changed)
task_description_placeholder: Write a description for your task (e.g., 'Buy groceries')
file_will_be_created: New file — will be created on save
task_file_placeholder: Path to the file where the task is located (e.g., 'Projects/Tasks.md')
task_field_menu_not_a_task: Cursor is not on a task line
task_duration_invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes greater than 0
task_drag_drop_error: Couldn't move the task (the file may have changed)
task_recurrence_placeholder: e.g., every week, every month on the 1st
confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this task?
habit_folder_path_desc: Path to the folder containing habit notes (default: daily plan/daily routine/habit)
habit_show_single_daytime_label_desc: Show a small daytime label next to habit names in Grid and Weekly when a habit has one daytime
habit_default_color_desc: CSS color (hex, rgb, name) for habits without a color
habit_default_color_placeholder: e.g., #00b499 or leave empty for theme default
show_habit_sub_area_field_desc: Shows a sub-area field in the habit editor, filled from the subfolders of the chosen area
habit_streak_deadline_tooltip: Last day to keep your streak
habit_related_file_placeholder: Link to a supporting note (e.g. '[[My note]]')
habit_related_file_hint_missing: Note not found — the link will stay unresolved until you create it
habit_name_exists: A habit with that name already exists
habit_daytime_required: Select at least one daytime; defaulting to morning
